preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxAmount(1) to set the maximum transaction amount to the minimum possible value (1 wei). This will effectively stop all user transactions (except for the owner who is excluded from fee and maxTxAmount checks) by making any transfer amount > 1 fail the require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) check in the _transfer function.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The GDG token contract has a setMaxTxAmount function that can only be called by the owner. By setting _maxTxAmount to 1 (the minimum value), the owner can effectively block all user transactions since the _transfer function requires amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner addresses. The owner is excluded from this check via _isExcludedFromFee mapping. This is a classic owner privilege abuse where the owner can disrupt normal token functionality.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxAmount(1) to set the maximum transaction amount to 1 wei, which will make most user transactions fail while allowing the owner to continue transacting freely.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the GDG contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setMaxTxAmount(1) on the GDG contract. 4. Verify that _maxTxAmount is now equal to 1.
